title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

title: Product Manager, Courier Delivery Experience
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We seek a Product Manager to join our Courier and Delivery Experience (CDX) team. This role will focus on ensuring world-class courier and consumer delivery experiences while continually evolving the delivery process with a future-oriented mindset. The Courier and Delivery Experience team owns the experiences that elevate every Wolt delivery, from the moment a courier opens the app to every order they accept, all the way to dropping an order off at the customer's doorstep. The team sits at the intersection of a multi-sided marketplace product, real-world operations, and safety, and the work directly moves how reliable Wolt feels to consumers and how satisfied our couriers are when delivering.

You will play a crucial role in shaping the courier experience, ensuring that our couriers feel valued and supported while enhancing the efficiency of deliveries. By blending operational expertise with a deep understanding of courier needs, you will improve the user journey from onboarding couriers to completing deliveries. From designing new features that boost courier satisfaction to refining delivery processes, your work will contribute to key metrics across courier engagement, performance, and satisfaction. You will also be influential in shaping the evolution of the live delivery experience for our courier partners, the merchant courier interaction at pickup and the consumer courier interaction at the doorstep via the Courier app surfaces. 

The ideal candidate will have an exceptional track record in product management, with proven success in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, product, and operations. You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Working in partnership with business stakeholders, you will also collaborate on cross-team initiatives, contributing to the broader business strategy while ensuring a deep understanding of the courier experience.

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products
  • Expertise in developing user-centric products, with the ability to address complex user experience-related challenges.
  • Demonstrated expertise in supporting cross-functional teams and fostering operational excellence in fast-paced, high-demand industries.
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. title: Senior HR Generalist (2-year contract)
description:
We are currently looking for an HR Generalist join our international HR Department, and provide support to our offices in Germany.

The post-holder is responsible to provide a robust HR service and support to the Human Resources Department’s daily operations: personnel administration, benefits, payroll etc. He/she mainly works within a framework of established HR processes, procedures and standard work instructions as determined by the centralised HR department and applicable local country legislations.

  • Be responsible for all aspect of the administration involved in the employee life cycle including procedures in TransPerfect’s offices in Germany

  • Partner with the recruitment and relevant department to best coordinate employees’ onboarding

  •  Coordinate relevant training programs

  • Support the implementation and monitoring of performance evaluation programs

  • Have a robust understanding and practical knowledge of Company processes and policies to advise employees and managers

  • Maintain and implement HRIS (i.e. Workday) and employee file integrity

  • Run and create standard reporting from HRIS (turnover, benefits, etc.)

  • Administer different benefit plans in compliance with local regulations and Company procedures and policies

  • Support and advise on employee relations procedures e.g. grievances and disciplinaries. This could involve arranging meetings and taking notes

  • Perform operational support to the different office(s) in Germany

  • Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for your role and assigned by your manager/supervisor


  • Minimum 4 years HR experience within a multinational company

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent, preferably with specialisation in Human Resources

  • Proficiency level in MS Office (specifically Excel)

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

  • Excellent German communication skills (written and verbal)

  • General knowledge and understanding of benefits/compensation

  • Ability to maintain professionalism and confidentiality in all situations

  • Ability to handle sensitive information in a confidential manner

  • Positive attitude, resiliency, and the ability to produce high quality and volume at a fast pace

  • Ability to work effectively and independently across organizational boundaries

  • Attention to detail, problem-solving competencies

  • Working knowledge with HRIS e.g. Workday

  • Problem solving and analytical skills

  • Maintain flexibility to take on additional responsibilities, as needed

title: Junior Data Engineer & MarTech Specialist (Mobile Apps) (m/w/d)
description:
About Us

Customlytics is the leading app marketing agency & consultancy in the DACH region. Our international team of professionals from more than 10 nationalities helps apps succeed and drives the professionalization of the app industry by working with every relevant app business in the market.  

Can you imagine a world without apps? Neither can we! 

You don't need a background in marketing to thrive here, f you have a passion for data structures, technical integration, and problem-solving, we will onboard you on the rest! As a Junior Data Engineer & MarTech Specialist, you will work at the intersection of data infrastructure and marketing technology. You will support the setup, maintenance, and monitoring of clients' mobile app marketing and tracking systems, helping ensure data quality across data pipelines, Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs like Adjust and AppsFlyer), and campaign analytics platforms.


Your mission

  • Support the setup, maintenance, and monitoring of Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as Adjust and AppsFlyer, helping ensure accurate tracking and attribution functionality.  
  • Help maintain and structure clients' product feeds, campaign datasets, and automated data pipelines, ensuring high data quality and reliability.  
  • Assist in identifying and troubleshooting basic tracking, event collection, or data integration issues across mobile app campaigns.  
  • Support the connection of marketing tools, ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), and data sources to improve campaign visibility and reporting workflows.  
  • Contribute to dashboard creation and visualization updates in tools such as Clarisights, Adverity, and Google Sheets to support data-driven decision-making.  
  • Collaborate with senior team members, consultants, and client developers to understand technical requirements and support implementation tasks.


Your profile

  • Background: Background in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related discipline, with an interest in marketing data, tracking systems, and campaign attribution.
  •  Product Feeds: Basic understanding of product feed structures; experience with tools like ProductsUp is a plus.
  •  Mobile Measurement Partners: Introductory knowledge of MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer); willingness to learn troubleshooting and tracking fundamentals. 
  • Advertising Platforms: Familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads, or TikTok (hands-on experience is a plus).
  • Data & Reporting: experience working with Excel or Google Sheets; understanding of simple data handling and reporting. 
  • Automation & AI Tools: Interest in tools such as ChatGPT, Make.com, or Google Sheets automation; no advanced experience required. 
  • Analytical Mindset: Curious and detail-oriented, with a willingness to learn how data supports marketing decisions. 
  • Communication & Collaboration: Able to communicate clearly, ask questions, and work effectively within a team. 
  • Working Style: Structured, proactive, and eager to develop technical and analytical skills. 
  • Languages: Fluent in English (spoken and written); German is a plus but not required.


Your Extra

  • Your Growth & Development: Access to certifications, 360° feedback, and salary progression. Real opportunities to grow together with your team and the company.

title: Founding Brand Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. 


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office.

...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.

...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.

...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer – Business Automation (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir verantworten u.a. das zentrale CRM HubSpot, über das alle Prozesse unserer Wertschöpfungskette laufen. Du übernimmst dabei eine gewachsene, produktive Automatisierungslandschaft: Ein Teil unserer Geschäftslogik läuft heute als Custom Code direkt in HubSpot-Workflows, ein Teil in eigenen Backend-Services. Beides gehört dir – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wohin sich diese Architektur entwickelt.

Softwareentwicklung

  • Entwicklung TypeScript-basierter Automatisierungen und Services entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette im HubSpot CRM

  • Entwicklung von HubSpot-Apps und UI Extensions (React) für unsere internen Teams – von CRM-Cards bis Workflow-Actions

  • Verwaltung von Scopes, Token-Rotation, App-Versionierung und Deployments (CI/CD)

Automatisierungen & Workflows

API- & Event-getriebene Architektur

  • Einsatz der HubSpot CRM APIs für Objekte, Assoziationen und Batch-Operationen

  • Nutzung von Webhooks & Subscriptions für Event-getriebene Synchronisation

  • Aufbau robuster Retry-, Error-Handling- und Monitoring-Mechanismen – inklusive bewusstem Umgang mit Rate-Limits und Datenvolumen

Datenmodellierung & CRM-Architektur

  • Definition von Objektbeziehungen, Ownership-Logiken und Lifecycle-Zuständen

  • Sicherstellung von Datenkonsistenz über mehrere Systeme hinweg

Integrationen & Plattform-Strategie

  • Technische Anbindung interner sowie externer Systeme (z.B. Abrechnung, Metering, Energie-Backends, eigener Tech Stack)

  • Aufbau sauberer Schnittstellen zwischen HubSpot und produktiven Kernsystemen

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der langfristigen CRM- & Integrationsarchitektur – inklusive der schrittweisen Verlagerung komplexer Geschäftslogik aus Workflows in testbare Backend-Services

Software-Engineering

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen, mit klarem Schwerpunkt Backend

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript; solide React-Kenntnisse für unsere CRM-Cards und UI Extensions (NestJS ist ein Plus)

  • Verständnis für saubere API-Verträge, Versionierung und Testing – du weißt, wann ein Pattern hilft und wann es Zeremonie ist

Systemdenken: Automatisierung & Skalierung

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit API- und Event-getriebener Integration von SaaS-Plattformen (CRM, Billing o.Ä.) – praktische Erfahrung mit der HubSpot Developer Platform (Private/Public Apps, OAuth 2.0, Scopes, Webhooks, UI Extensions) ist ein starkes Plus

title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d) – Core Team
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst.

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird.

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert.

In den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle

  • Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut

  • Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen

Danach

  • Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung

  • Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird

  • Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis

  • Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen

  • Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede

  • Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun


Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung

  • Du kannst ein Datenmodell beurteilen und eine Architekturdiskussion moderieren, ohne sie an dich zu reißen

  • Du willst wieder oder weiter Code schreiben, bevor du führst, und siehst das als Vorteil, nicht als Umweg

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in Messstellenbetrieb, Abrechnung, Marktkommunikation oder Mieterstrom. Du kennst Begriffe wie Messkonzept, MaLo oder OBIS nicht nur aus Wikipedia

  • Business-Verständnis: Du denkst vom Geschäftsmodell des Betreibers her, nicht vom Feature. Du kannst erklären, welche Anforderung Umsatz sichert, welche Risiko reduziert und welche nur schön ist

  • Du gibst direktes Feedback und hältst es aus, direktes Feedback zu bekommen

  • Du kannst Nein sagen, zu Stakeholdern und zum eigenen Team, und begründen, warum

  • Du fühlst dich in einem Startup wohl, in dem Strukturen noch entstehen und du sie mitgestaltest

  • Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, weil Fachlichkeit, Kunden und ein Großteil der Kommunikation deutsch sind


Warum wir?

  • Eine Führungsrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einer wachsenden Engineering-Organisation, mit einem Einstieg, der dich nicht ins kalte Wasser wirft

  • Direkter Draht zum CTO und Mitsprache bei der Teamstruktur, nicht nur bei der Umsetzung

description:

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the Role

MUBI's web platform is where millions of people discover, read about and watch films. It's a streaming player, a curated catalogue and an editorial publication in one, and it has to feel fast and considered in every one of the countries we operate in.

We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend.

You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:

  • Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability.

  • Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components.

  • Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies.

  • Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there.

  • Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty.

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript.

  • Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals.

  • Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS.

  • Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty.

  • Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices.

  • Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear.

  • An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up).

  • Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering.

  • Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers.

  • Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

 

About the Client Education team

Every hx customer's success depends on their teams knowing how to use our platform well - not just how to click through it, but how to build genuinely good pricing models with it. Client Education exists to make that happen. We sit at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, and Customer teams, turning new features and platform capability into training, certification, and documentation that our clients and delivery partners can actually learn from.

The team owns the full learning journey: onboarding new clients, building certification pathways, producing courses and video content, and supporting partners who deliver training on our behalf. As hx's product surface has grown - Decision Engine, Pricing & Rating, Portfolio Intelligence, Submission Triage, and our AI agents - so has the volume and complexity of what we need to teach, and we're growing the team to keep pace.

We're looking for a Client Education Associate to join as a core part of this effort. Your focus will be delivering technical training directly to clients and partners, and supporting the team in building and maintaining the courses and certifications that make that training possible. You'll need enough technical grounding to be credible in front of a room of actuaries and developers, and enough teaching instinct to make complex material land.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Deliver technical training sessions, live and online, to clients and partners - covering everything from platform fundamentals to how to build pricing models using hx's AI agents and product tooling.

  • Build and maintain high-quality course content (online modules, video tutorials, workshop materials) that keeps pace with new product releases and evolving client needs.

  • Support the design and delivery of certification assessments, including practical exercises where candidates build real pricing tools in the hx platform.

  • Partner with Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to translate new features into training material clients can actually use from day one.

  • Contribute to our partner enablement programme, helping external delivery partners onboard and deliver hx training to a consistent standard.

  • Help maintain and improve our course health and documentation processes, flagging content that's fallen out of date or out of line with current product naming and messaging.

 

What you'll need to have done

  • Delivered training, workshops, or technical explanations to a non-technical or semi-technical audience, and can point to material you've built or taught from.

  • Studied Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or built equivalent hands-on comfort with programming languages (Python or similar) through experience.

  • Worked hands-on with SaaS tools, APIs, or similar technical products, even without a formal software engineering background.

  • Taken the initiative to build or improve a course, process, or piece of learning content, rather than just following someone else's structure.

  • Communicated confidently and clearly with clients or external stakeholders, adjusting technical depth to fit the audience in front of you.

  • Worked well in an environment where scope shifts and you're expected to figure things out rather than wait for a fully defined brief.

 

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You'd rather follow a fixed curriculum than build and adapt training material as the product changes under you.

  • You're not comfortable being hands-on with technical concepts and tooling, even at a foundational level.

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than pulling in context from Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to get training right.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this.

 

Benefits

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview Process

  6. We offer!

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

In short

We're looking for a Video Lead to shoot and edit for tem. Full-time, £70,000, based anywhere in the UK with shoots around the country.

tem connects businesses directly with the renewable generators that power them, which makes it an unusually diverse thing to film: solar and wind sites, the people who run them, the businesses buying from them, and the engineers building the technology in between. Here's some of what we've made so far: here, here, here and here.

The work we want to make

Two kinds of video, held to the same standard.

Considered films, where pacing, sound and framing carry the story and every shot is there for a reason. The kind someone who has never thought about energy watches to the end, because they've started to care about the person in it.

And social pieces that aren't templates: short cuts made with real intent, where the rhythm, timing, sound design and effects all serve the idea. Native to the platform, unmistakably crafted.

You'll move between the two in the same week without either one slipping.

If you're freelance - most of the best shooter-editors work for themselves, and we understand why. Here's what we'd want you to know.

This isn't corporate video. Generator stories, customer films, policy explainers, engineering pieces and people-led series - a social series one week, a customer film the next. When it's worth moving fast, we can go from idea to published within a week, if that’s what we collectively decide.

You'd be building something, not borrowing it. Rather than picking up someone else's style for a few weeks, you'd shape what tem's video looks and feels like, and build a body of work around it over years. You're expected, and encouraged, to argue when you see a better way.

Fewer feedback rounds. One brand, one small team, and a direct line to whoever wrote the brief. You learn tem once, properly.

The money. £70,000, stock options, paid holiday, and no invoices to chase or quiet months to plan around.

What you'll own

tem's video from first shot to final export: how it's planned, shot and cut, and how it looks and sounds across everything we publish. You'll sit in the Brand team and report into the Content Lead.

  • Shoots. Planning properly - schedule, kit, shot list, a recce where it's worth it - then staying alert on the day for what the plan couldn't know. Running most shoots solo, and knowing when a piece needs extra crew and when a phone and good instincts will do.

  • People. Most of the generators, engineers and finance directors you'll film have never been on camera. Putting them at ease and getting the real version of them is half the job.

  • The edit (around 70% of your week). Cutting, grading, mixing and titling in Premiere Pro. Giving short social pieces the same care as the long ones, letting the considered films breathe, and making something good from very little when there's no shoot.

  • Story and style. Turning a brief or rough idea into how it should be shot and sequenced, pushing back when you see a better version, and developing a visual language for tem video over time.

How we use AI (and how we don't)

We're not looking for someone to make AI-generated films - our content works because it's real. We use tools where they earn their place: transcription and paper edits, selects, audio clean-up, subtitles, cutdowns and versioning, the occasional fix in post, and pre-production like moodboards and storyboards. We want someone curious enough to try new tools, with the judgement to know when not to.

What we're looking for

  • A portfolio, wherever it lives, that shows both halves: considered, human storytelling and social work cut with real intent.

  • A professional standard at both shooting and editing.

  • Speed without losing control.

  • Good with people, on and off camera.

  • Sensible, hands-on use of AI tools in a real pipeline.

  • UK-based and happy to travel for shoots.

Bonus points

  • Premiere Pro, since it's what we cut in.

  • Colour, sound design or motion graphics beyond the basics.

  • A freelance or small-studio background.

  • An interest in energy, climate or tech.

What you get

  • £70,000 salary, reviewed twice a year.

  • Your say in what video kit we invest in for the content team.

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays (swap them for the ones that matter to you), and your birthday off.

How to apply

description:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

That sounds cool - what does a Customer Success Lead have to do with it?

Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs and is growing fast in secondary care. To keep up with how the NHS is organising itself, our Account Management team has just moved to a regional model, with leads for London, the South and the North. The goal is simple: join up what we’re learning across primary care, secondary care, acute, community and mental health, and make sure the best opportunities get surfaced across the whole of England, not just in one set of ICBs.

We’re hiring a Customer Success Lead for the North. You’ll lead a team of Customer Success Managers across primary and secondary care and be the strategic, zoomed-out view of the region. Your team is close to the accounts. Your job is to spot the patterns across them, turn what they’re hearing into strategy, and help Accurx show up at a regional level.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Lead

  • Lead and grow a team of CSMs. You’ll start with three CSMs, each with their own region, customers and stage of the customer journey. You’ll coach them, unblock them and help them do the best work of their careers.

  • Bring two very different care settings together. Primary care is about deepening trust we’ve built over years. Secondary care is about firsts: new services, longer implementations and goalposts that move. You’ll work out what connects them, what doesn’t, and where learnings from one can speed up the other.

  • Turn insight into strategy. Your team will feed you what’s happening on the ground. You’ll spot trends, gaps and duplicated effort across the region and turn them into projects, goals and growth opportunities in products like Accurx Scribe and Total Triage.

  • Own the commercial picture for your region. You’ll keep a close eye on churn, risk, renewals and upsell across your team’s accounts, and represent the region at our weekly business reviews with the exec team.

  • Build the playbook with your fellow leads. The regional model is brand new. Alongside the leads for London and the South, you’ll shape how we work, what best practice looks like and how we scale it.

  • Be the link across the business. You’ll work closely with implementation, transformation, support and business development, making sure the voice of our customers shapes where Accurx goes next.


You should apply if...

  • You’ve led customer-facing teams. You have a few years of people management in customer success or account management, and you love helping others grow.

  • You’ve built things from the ground up. You’ve been on a startup to scale-up journey, worn a lot of hats, and taken customers from never having heard of you to being your biggest advocates.

  • You care about depth, not volume. You’ve looked after long-standing, strategic relationships rather than a high-volume queue, and you know that trust is what makes customers stick.

  • You can zoom out. You don’t need to be in the weeds of every account. You’re great at spotting patterns, asking the right questions and knowing where your team needs you most.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You’re happy to try something, get it wrong, learn and go again. Process is something you create, not something you wait for.

  • You’re a big collaborator. You’re an incredible communicator and listener, and you know the best outcomes come from working across teams.

  • You’re curious about the NHS. Healthcare experience is welcome but not essential. What matters is empathy for the pressure the NHS is under and the patience to build trust in a complex system.

Today the stack holds because individuals across Ops, Growth, Finance and Engineering compensate locally. They learned the quirks and built workarounds. You will be the single accountable owner of that layer. Not a support function, not a ticketing desk, not a BI factory.

description:
Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

title: Geologist
description:
About the company

The transition to a sustainable future requires discovering new mineral resources to power clean technologies and renewable energy solutions. From lithium for electric vehicle batteries, to copper for wind turbines, and rare earth elements for electronics, these minerals are the building blocks of our energy transition.

Lithosquare radically speeds up mineral exploration by combining foundational AI, geological expertise, and real-world data to reduce uncertainty, prioritize the right targets, reduce costs and accelerate discovery. Based in Paris, Lithosquare gathered an exceptional team of geologists, scientists, AI engineers, and data specialists to work as one, from field sampling to model optimization and push the boundaries of what's possible.

About the job

As a Geologist at Lithosquare, you will play a key hybrid role at the intersection of field operation (around 20%) and office work (80%). You will support field campaign execution while actively contributing to data compilation, targeting, and QA/QC across our exploration portfolio.

This is a dynamic, cross-functional role: you will divide your time between field work (reconnaissance, sampling, drilling support) and office work in Paris, working closely with senior geologists, data scientists, and AI engineers. We are looking for someone rigorous, curious about technological innovation, and eager to learn while helping build the next generation of AI-assisted exploration tools.

What you'll do

Reporting to the Senior Geologists and the VP Asset Development, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Field Execution & Support: Support and participate in all phases of field exploration programs, including regional reconnaissance, surface sampling, geophysical surveys, and drilling campaigns. Assist with field logistics while ensuring compliance with international health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.

  • Data Compilation & QA/QC: Lead geological data entry, compilation, and QA/QC processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of exploration datasets across all projects.

  • Office Work: Assist senior geologists with geological data interpretation to support exploration targeting, field campaign planning, technical reporting, GIS mapping, data management, and project evaluation. Contribute to the preparation of maps, presentations, and technical documentation.

  • Bridge Geology & AI Tech: Work closely with the tech and AI teams to test, refine, and improve Lithosquare’s AI platform, ensuring our digital tools reflect field realities and technical needs.

  • Reporting & Collaboration: Prepare clear technical summaries, data visualizations, and maps for internal reviews and partner updates.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in mineral exploration geology

  • Degree in Geology or Earth Sciences, with solid foundations in metallogeny, structural geology, or geochemistry

  • First significant field exposure (mapping, sampling, or core logging) with a willingness to spend significant time in the field as required by projects

  • Data-driven & Rigorous: A structured approach to data management, QA/QC, and documentation; familiarity with GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS) and/or geological modeling software is a plus

  • Tech-curious & Innovative mindset: Genuine interest in how AI and technology can transform traditional exploration methods

  • Strong Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary team (geologists, data scientists, AI engineers), interact professionally with partners and produce clear, synthetic & high-quality deliverables

  • Mission-driven: Passionate about the energy transition and solving complex physical-world challenges through innovation

  • Fluency in English is required with previous exposure to international exchanges

  • Valid Driver's License (Permis B) is a bonus

Perks & Benefits

  • 🏢 Offices located in the heart of Paris

  • 🌱 Strong culture of ownership & entrepreneurship

  • 🌍 Opportunity to significantly contribute to energy transition

  • 👥 Collaborative work environment with world-class experts in geology, AI, and data science

  • 🔄 Flexible work arrangements enabling work-life balance

  • 🚴 Sustainable mobility allowance (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

  • 🏋️ Gym pass

  • 🎉 Frequent team drinks, events & regular off-sites

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🍽️ Meal vouchers and health insurance coverage (Alan)

Join Lithosquare and become part of a passionate team driving innovation at the intersection of AI and Earth exploration. Let's make a tangible difference together!

description:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

Location: Hybrid from Paris or full remote

Role Overview

ScorePlay signs deals with some of the biggest organizations in sports, and every one of them starts with a contract. We are hiring a Commercial Contracts Counsel to own that: redlines, negotiations, signatures, the whole thing. You work directly with Lou, our General Counsel, and are the first point of contact for Sales on contracts.

What you will do

1. Contracts

  • You review, redline and negotiate the agreements that close our deals: MSAs, service agreements, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs, with clubs, leagues, federations, broadcasters and brands, often across several countries.

  • Sales comes to you when a deal is stuck on terms, and your job is to unstick it: fast turnaround, pragmatic fallbacks, and the judgement to know when a point is worth holding.

  • You partner with Sales, Finance, RevOps and Customer Success so contract terms match how the deal is actually priced, booked and delivered.

  • You take a share of vendor and partner agreements alongside Lou, split based on what is moving and where you want to build depth.

2. Tools, processes and enablement

  • We use AI heavily in contract work: drafting, first-pass reviews, summarizing counterparty terms. We want someone who genuinely enjoys this and keeps looking for a smarter way to handle the repetitive part.

  • Our legal playbook is young. You execute it, then you help Lou refine it with what you see in real negotiations.

3. Privacy and security

  • You contribute to customer security, privacy and vendor due-diligence questionnaires, and to DPA and international transfer questions. The heart of the role is contracts, with room to grow into broader compliance work if that interests you.

What we are looking for

  • You know commercial contracts inside out. 3 to 5 years of experience, most of it in-house, with contracts at the core of what you did.

  • You work autonomously. Give you an MSA or a set of customer redlines and you come back with a position, a fallback and a recommendation.

  • You ship fast. A solid answer today beats a perfect one on Friday, and you're comfortable making the call at 80% certainty.

  • You're resourceful. When something is unclear, you dig, you ask, you find a way, rather than waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You like helping people win. Supporting a Sales team means being responsive, available, and genuinely happy when a deal signs because of your work.

  • You're excited by AI. You already use it in your legal work, or you can't wait to, and you keep looking for smarter ways to handle the repetitive parts.

What’s fun about this role

  • You negotiate international contracts with some of the biggest names in sports: clubs, leagues, federations and broadcasters on every continent.

  • As our first commercial counsel, you own your function and you're the main partner of the Sales team on both sides of the Atlantic.

  • You sit in sales calls with senior stakeholders at major sports organizations, on deals worth USD 50k to 500k a year. When a deal closes, you're usually one of the key players who made it work.

  • Small team, short loops. You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table, build playbooks, experiment with AI and new tools, and learn a ton along the way.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

About the Role
We're hiring Linkup's first SDR/BDR, a hybrid pipeline-generation role covering both sides of the funnel: qualifying inbound signups and running structured outbound into our priority segments (AI-native companies, GTM tooling providers, enterprise and regulated accounts).
You'll work closely with our VP Sales, picking accounts, drafting outbound, and partnering with AEs to turn interest into qualified pipeline. High ownership, fast feedback loop.

  • Monitor and pre-qualify inbound signups against our ICP (AI-native, GTM tooling, enterprise), then route to the right AE

  • Support first-touch qualification alongside AEs, learning our lead framework (ICP fit, pain, volume, timing, right entry point) as you go

  • Keep every touch logged in Attio

  • Help tune outbound messaging and channels as we scale campaigns across segments


Why This Role Matters
This is the first dedicated pipeline-generation hire at Linkup. Get it right and it compounds into every AE's quota.

You're a Great Fit If You

  • Have 0 to 2 years in SDR/BDR, or a first job out of a fast-paced, competitive environment (sales, consulting, we care about drive more than tenure)

  • Are comfortable with high-volume outbound and don't wait to be told what to do

  • Write clean, direct, non-generic outreach, no template-speak

  • Are curious about AI/agents and can hold a real conversation with a technical buyer, even without an engineering background

  • Want ownership fast, this role works closely with sales leadership, not layers of management

Our Stack
Attio (CRM), LemList (outbound), Slack, Notion, Apollo/Sales Navigator (prospecting), Snitcher (visitor ID), RB2B

About Linkup
Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

  • Monitor account health (usage, engagement, satisfaction)

description:
La philosophie PureGym

Membre du groupe international PureGym, nous sommes le deuxième plus grand opérateur européen de salles de sport. Avec plus de 700 salles à travers le monde, nous sommes actuellement présents au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Arabie saoudite, en Suisse et au Danemark.

Nous formons une équipe dynamique et internationale animée par notre mission : améliorer la santé et le bien-être de la population. Notre objectif est d’offrir à tous, partout dans le monde, une expérience de remise en forme de grande qualité et abordable. Nous proposons :

·       Un abonnement gratuit à la salle de sport pour vous + 1 personne

·       Des avantages exclusifs grâce à notre programme d’avantages sociaux, comprenant des réductions substantielles sur une large gamme de produits et de services, tant au sein de nos salles de sport qu’auprès d’autres prestataires externes

·       Nos bureaux sont situés dans l’agglomération de Zurich et disposent d’un accès direct à la salle de sport

·       Nos horaires de travail sont flexibles

·       Nous offrons 25 jours de congés + 1 jour de congé personnel

 

Le poste

Lieu : Romandie / Berne / Seeland bernois - Base de terrain 
 
Type : Temps plein 
 
Type de contrat : Permanent

Une opportunité passionnante de rejoindre PureGym en tant que technicien d'installations !

Notre équipe de gestion des installations veille chaque jour à ce que les clubs PureGym de toute la Suisse soient sûrs, opérationnels et prêts à accueillir les adhérents. En étroite collaboration avec la direction des clubs, nos collègues internes et nos prestataires externes, nous coordonnons la maintenance, les réparations, les activités de mise en conformité et les améliorations continues au sein d’un portefeuille national de clubs en pleine expansion. En tant que technicien de gestion des installations, vous serez un membre clé de l’équipe sur le terrain, principalement basé en Romandie et effectuant régulièrement des missions en Suisse romande. Ce poste implique des déplacements quotidiens entre les différents clubs.  

En tant que technicien de maintenance, vous apporterez un soutien technique sur le terrain aux clubs PureGym, principalement en Suisse romande et en partie en Suisse alémanique, en veillant à ce que les installations soient sûres, fonctionnelles et bien entretenues grâce à des réparations, de la maintenance préventive, des inspections et le dépannage technique.

Vos principales responsabilités :

  • Effectuer des réparations mineures sur les équipements de fitness, les portes, les installations sanitaires, le mobilier, les vestiaires, les douches et les espaces communs des clubs

  • Effectuer la maintenance préventive, le dépannage technique et les inspections régulières des clubs

  • Traiter et mettre à jour les ordres de travail dans le système de gestion numérique des tickets (ServiceChannel)

  • Identifier les défauts et signaler les problèmes récurrents ou critiques pour la sécurité

  • Inspecter et consigner l’état des appareils électriques portables après avoir suivi une formation adéquate et obtenu l’autorisation nécessaire

  • Participer aux contrôles relatifs à l’hygiène de l’eau, à l’éclairage de secours, à la sécurité incendie, aux issues de secours et à la sécurité opérationnelle

  • Coordonner les visites des petits prestataires et vérifier les travaux réalisés sur place

  • Apporter son soutien lors des nouvelles ouvertures, des rénovations, des remises en service techniques et des projets de moindre envergure

  • Transporter les outils, les pièces de rechange et le petit matériel d’un club à l’autre

  • Entretenir de manière responsable le véhicule de fonction, les outils, les appareils de test et les stocks

 

Ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre :

  • Un poste varié, sur le terrain, offrant une grande autonomie

  • Un véhicule de fonction entièrement équipé, des outils et du matériel de contrôle

  • Des formations techniques et des opportunités de développement professionnel

  • Un impact direct sur le fonctionnement du club et l'expérience des membres

  • Pas d’astreinte

  • Le salaire et les avantages sociaux seront discutés avec les candidats intéressés lors d’un premier entretien téléphonique avec les RH


Profil recherché

  • Formation professionnelle achevée dans un métier technique ou artisanal, tel que concierge, plombier, peintre, mécanicien ou équivalent

  • Expérience pratique dans le domaine des réparations, de l’entretien ou de la gestion des bâtiments

  • Bonnes compétences pratiques et connaissances de base des installations techniques et des systèmes techniques du bâtiment

  • Volonté de suivre une formation pour l'inspection des appareils électriques portables

  • Maîtrise des smartphones, des tablettes et des systèmes de billetterie numérique

  • Style de travail autonome, structuré et axé sur les solutions

  • Fiabilité, sens du service et rigueur dans la documentation des travaux

  • Des déplacements quotidiens sont à prévoir dans toute la Suisse ; le fait de résider en Suisse romande ou dans les cantons de Berne ou de Fribourg constitue un atout

Langues 

  • La maîtrise parfaite du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, est obligatoire

  • Une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais ou de l'allemand est requise

Permis de conduire 

  • Un permis de conduire de catégorie B en cours de validité est obligatoire

  • Disponibilité à utiliser un véhicule de fonction pour des missions dans toute la Suisse

description:

Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbaren Einfluss auf unsere Fertigungsprozesse – von der ersten Idee über die Konzeption bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Lösungen. Wir bieten dir Gestaltungsspielraum für deine fachliche und kreative Entfaltung, kurze Entscheidungswege sowie ein hohes Mass an Eigenverantwortung. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie softwaregestützte Produktionslösungen bei uns entstehen und wachsen.

YOUR PLAYGROUND

  • Du entwickelst Softwarelösungen für unsere Produktions- und Prüfanlagen im Bereich Production Engineering

  • In deiner Rolle planst und realisierst du Projekte im Betriebsmittelbau, von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung (inkl. Bestellungen) und Inbetriebnahme

  • Bestehende Prozesse und Softwarelösungen betreust, wartest und entwickelst du kontinuierlich weiter – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion und Engineering

  • Du stellst den Betrieb sowie die Wartung produktionsnaher Datennetzwerke und Server sicher

  • Die fachliche Unterstützung und das Coaching von Informatik-Lernenden gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich


YOUR PROFILE

kreativ innovativ mutig / offen für Neues / lösungsorientiert / bodenständig / selbstständig / eigenverantwortung

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der C‑Programmierung (National Instruments CVI C) werden vorausgesetzt; Erfahrung mit SPS‑Systemen, idealerweise Siemens S7, ist ein Pluspunkt

  • Das Zusammenspiel von Software, Elektronik und Mechanik begeistert dich und motiviert dich in deiner täglichen Arbeit

Das findest du bei uns

1 / spannende elektronische Produkte und deren Betriebsmittel

2 / einen prall bepackten Wissens-und Erfahrungsrucksack für deine berufliche Zukunft
